## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle treatise by [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng is a focused study of the doctrine of the *Three Treasures* (三寶 — *triratna*: the Buddha, the Dharma, the Saṅgha) as it is set out in the *Míngfǎ pǐn* 明法品 ("Chapter on Clarifying the Dharma," chapter 18 of the *[60-fascicle Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0001)* / chapter 18 of the *[80-fascicle Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)*). The chapter is one of the doctrinally densest of the *Avataṃsaka* and was the subject of intensive Tang Huáyán-school study.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's mature period, c. 670 – 712 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The doctrinal substance treats the *Three Treasures* in their *Avataṃsaka* configuration — the Buddha as the cosmic *Vairocana*, the Dharma as the boundless *dharma-realm*, and the Saṅgha as the assembly of Samantabhadra-bodhisattvas — and explicates the relations among the three within the *Avataṃsaka*'s own doctrinal frame. The work's *zhāng* / "treatise" format and 2-fascicle length make it one of the medium-scale studies in Fǎzàng's corpus, intermediate between the brief synopsis-works (*[Zhǐ guī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0085)*, *[Cè lín](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0086)*) and the major commentaries (*[Tànxuán jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0008)*, *[Wǔ jiào zhāng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)*).
